bibl.title: Pindar, Paean 6: Genre as Embodied Cultural Knowledge.
bibl.seg: Sarah Olsen, Pindar, Paean 6: Genre as Embodied Cultural Knowledge.

Margaret Foster, Leslie Kurke & Naomi Weiss (edd.), Genre in Archaic and Classical Greek Poetry: Theories and Models = Studies in Archaic and Classical Greek Song, 4 = Mnemosyne. Supplements. 428 (Leiden, 2020) pp. 325-346.
bibl.note: Embodying the divine: paeanic choreia at Delphi in the Homeric Hymn to Apollo. - Embodying the paean: the dynamics of Pindar, Paean 6: Performance and reperformance: the possibilities for Paean 6; - Song and sense perception; - Divine action, mortal bodies; - A transgressive leap: Neoptolemus and Apollo; - Experiencing the origins of the paean. - Conclusion.
